items.summary: A survey conducted by Ipsos for the DeFi Education Fund found that 22% of Americans have ever owned or used crypto, up from 18%, while past-year use held flat at 13%.

items.title: Fed Stands Pat, Bitcoin Holds Steady—But a December Rate Hike Is in Play
items.summary: The Federal Reserve left rates unchanged Wednesday in a 10-2 vote, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack favoring a hike.

items.title: Aptos Advisor Leaves Post, Moves Meme-Fueled Campaign to Meta Stock
items.summary: Former Aptos advisor "Buzz” has left the crypto project and is turning his attention to Facebook's parent company Meta—here's why.

items.title: Wall Street’s Fast Money Fled Bitcoin ETFs, Sovereign Funds Stepped In
items.summary: Galaxy Research found that nine hedge funds and banks cut 68,000 BTC worth of spot ETF exposure as the cash-and-carry trade dried up, while wealth platforms and sovereign funds added.

items.title: Fed Rate Decision: What Markets and Bitcoin Traders Can Expect
items.summary: The Federal Reserve decides today at 2 p.m. ET and traders see a hold as near certain. Here's what it means for Bitcoin and stock markets.

items.title: JPMorgan, Coca-Cola Among 7 More Companies Objecting to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stocks
items.summary: Seven more companies, including JPMorgan Chase, Coca-Cola and Dell, have objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 33.

items.title: Moody's Rates Ripple's $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin A2, a Day After OCC Bank Approval
items.summary: The ratings agency cited RLUSD's Treasury-heavy reserves, but noted that holders have no direct ownership interest in them for now.

items.title: Morning Minute: Robinhood Misses, But Crypto Beats and Robinhood Chain Soars
items.summary: Vlad Tenev delivered the messaging that Robinhood Chain enthusiasts wanted to hear—and the market responded.

items.title: Bithumb Says Hackers Accessed Internal System, Leaking Personal Data
items.summary: South Korea's second-largest crypto exchange is checking whether customer data was exposed, as two other financial firms report breaches.

items.title: Coinbase Customer Data Hit in Analytics Vendor Breach, Funds ‘Not Impacted’
items.summary: The incident at analytics firm Amplitude hit a "small subset" of Coinbase customers, the exchange said, without saying how many.

items.title: Robinhood Misses Q3 Earnings as Crypto Revenue Rises and Prediction Market Bets Grow
items.summary: Robinhood posted record revenue of $1.42 billion but earned $0.51 per share, short of the $0.55 expected, as bets on sports and elections grew to $173 million and crypto edged up.

items.title: Robinhood Taps Ripple's Stablecoin, Treasury Software and Trading Loans
items.summary: Ripple's RLUSD stablecoin is live on Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp, and heads to the Robinhood app later this year as the companies deepen ties in treasury and institutional trading.

items.title: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor
items.summary: An expanded deal with Bitso puts Anchorage Digital Bank’s custody beneath both sides of the US-Mexico remittance route.

items.title: Intel, Oracle, IBM Join Objections to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Venue, Bringing Total to 26
items.summary: Intel, Oracle, IBM, and IonQ became the latest companies to object to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 26.

items.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
items.summary: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone's hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

items.title: Circle Pushes Deeper Into Latin America With USDC Settlement in Colombia
items.summary: A collaboration with payments-tech firm ACI Worldwide will pilot folding USDC settlement into Colombia’s instant-payments network.

items.title: OpenAI Proves ETH Is False, and Crypto Twitter Has Questions
items.summary: A new OpenAI paper declares ETH false, a claim that hundreds of research papers lean on. Crypto Twitter degens and serious mathematicians are abuzz.

items.title: McDonald's McRib Doesn't Actually Boost Bitcoin's Price, Sorry Everyone
items.summary: Crypto traders think the McRib’s return to McDonald's means a Bitcoin pump is coming. Experts say there is "no correlation at all."

items.title: Bitcoin Mining Firm Luxor Raises $16 Million to Scale Its AI Compute Push
items.summary: The CMT Digital-led round, which drew mining-hardware makers Canaan and MicroBT, will fund Luxor’s expansion into AI compute trading, hardware and derivatives.

items.title: Morning Minute: Tokenized Stock Battle Looms Over Robinhood’s Earnings Call
items.summary: One of crypto’s primary growth sectors for this upcoming cycle is under attack. Will Vlad Tenev speak up on today’s Robinhood earnings call?

items.title: Why This Team of Ninjas Is Tripling Down on Mining Bitcoin
items.summary: NIP Group says Bitcoin mining has “earned its place” as the esports giant swaps 247 million shares for more machines.

items.title: Ripple Wins Final OCC Approval for Trust Bank Behind $2.6B RLUSD Stablecoin
items.summary: The federally supervised bank will manage RLUSD's reserves and offer custody, as banking groups fight crypto charters in court.

items.title: Canada’s Draft Stablecoin Rules Cap Redemption Fees at 1% and Ban Yield
items.summary: Ottawa opened a 60-day consultation on draft rules requiring one-to-one reserves and fast redemption from stablecoin issuers, while keeping the ban on paying holders interest.

items.title: Bitcoin Wallet Fixes Critical Flaw That Redirected Funds to Attackers
items.summary: A confirmed exploit let rogue servers replace Electrum’s pending transactions, tricking users into redirecting Bitcoin to attacker addresses.

items.title: India’s CoinDCX Confirms $16 Million Loss Days After CEO Called It a ‘False Alarm’
items.summary: The Mumbai-based exchange says 15.99 million USDT was drained from wallets it retired after last year’s $44 million hack, bringing its combined losses to nearly $60 million—and it’s absorbing the hit.

items.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine Keeps Buying Ethereum But Pivots to Record Share Buybacks
items.summary: The firm added 10,452 ETH to reach 4.95% of supply, but its bigger move was repurchasing 2.04 million of its own shares—part of what it calls the largest equity buyback any crypto treasury company has run.

items.title: Strategy Pauses Bitcoin Buying, Spends $205M Buying Back STRC
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm's USD Cash balance fell to $242.4 million after its biggest weekly STRC buyback in more than a month.

items.title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80,000 Ahead of Fed Decision, Midterms
items.summary: Analysts point to a sell-off in AI stocks and ETF outflows, with HashKey's Tim Sun flagging $75,000 as the next key support level.
